A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the limiting power of the x2-test is a function of the unknown parameters, and the asymptotic efficiency of the estimator of these parameters affects the limiting power of x2-test.

the Pitman limiting powers of frequency x2-tests are not affected by the estimation of the unknown parameters, provided they are estimated from the samples by the method of maximum likelihoo or the minimum X2 method.
